programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Perfect Predator | S01E01
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. As a result of evolution, sharks have become natural hunters, perfect predators. They are extremely effective in chasing their prey in open waters and hunting from ambush. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Ocean Wanderer | S01E02
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: An insightful look at the arms race in the animal world. Thanks to the use of special photographic techniques, the program makers present the world from the perspective of both the predator and the prey. Lions, cheetahs, panthers and other carnivorous animals have to work hard to get food. You must first locate the victim and, before capturing it, use trickery and win the race with it. After all, when a predator catches its desired target, it must make sure that its competitor does not take its prey away... documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 6
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: 30 for 30: I'm Just Here for the Riot
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: How do you get wild animals on camera? Andreas Kieling follows the trail of the bears in Canada and the pandas in China - with patience, knowledge and a feeling for the right moment. (Station info).

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Dear gender theorists, you have to be very brave now: When young baboons are allowed to choose between different children's toys, girl monkeys prefer dolls, while monkey boys choose cars. It's not just our closest relatives in the animal kingdom who play: “Terra X” shows that birds, reptiles and even fish also enjoy a purposeless pastime.

programme.title: Animal high-flyers
programme.desc: The cheetah is the fastest land animal in the world. It accelerates to 100 km/h in just 3 seconds. Usain Bolt's 100m world record of 9.58 seconds would be pulverized by the big cat by just under 6 seconds. When diving, the peregrine falcon can reach a top speed of over 300 km/h. But you can't just speed up when you're moving around. The chameleon catches its prey with the fastest tongue in the animal world. \n\n5-part documentary about record holders in the fauna.

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to research the giant snakehead fish. Wherever the adaptable predator appears, it leaves nothing but devastation in its wake. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: It is considered the most poisonous spider in the world, the Brazilian wandering spider. In the dense rainforests of Costa Rica, adventurer Sean Duggan sets out on the trail of an unconfirmed sighting. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan travels to the Limpopo River in South Africa, where 17 people recently fell victim to crocodile attacks. Will he find a monster crocodile there? (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: Sean Duggan wants to get to the bottom of the myth of the Australian sea snake Down Under. He finds out that it could be the particularly poisonous tiger viper. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: Sean is searching for the legendary predator Megalania in Australia. The giant reptile is said to have been wiped out many millennia ago. Or does the killer reptile still exist? (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: The eastern cougar has been considered extinct for nearly a century. But recently there have been more and more alleged sightings of the species in the USA. Sean gets to the bottom of the mystery. (Station info).

programme.title: On the trail of predators
programme.desc: It weighs 136 kilos and can bite through the skull of its prey, the jaguar. Sean is searching the Yucatan Peninsula for the fearsome animal that has survived all climate catastrophes so far. (Station info).

programme.title: Secret Safari: Into the Wild
programme.desc: A young cheetah fights for survival. A Hartebeest defends its herd. Rangers help cocktail ants in the Ol Pejeta Sanctuary against dangerous intruders. (Station info).

programme.title: Secret Safari: Into the Wild
programme.desc: Impala Jaribou defends his territory against rivals while impressing a harem of 50 females. Meanwhile, rangers fight for the life of the injured female rhino Imara. (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: Being born in Africa comes with major obstacles. Predators are waiting to prey on the little ones. And not every young animal receives protection from a family group. (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: Is the lion the true ruler of animals? Herbivores and birds are underestimated in the savannah. Although they fight for survival with enormous endurance. (Station info).

programme.title: The African wildlife – life and survival
programme.desc: Mothers with babies, bullying teenagers and fighting males: things are turbulent in a baboon clan. How do the monkeys organize themselves among themselves and how do they cope with everyday life together? (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Peru: Surviving in the Andes
programme.desc: Welcome to the “Sunny Coast”! Peru (31 million inhabitants) in western Latin America is not exactly one of the continent's prominent countries; it cannot be due to its size (number three in South America) or its rich nature (cormorants). The coast, Andes and rainforest have many natural treasures.

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: Wild mountains and traces of British industrial history characterize Eryri. Between harsh nature, tourism and gentle agriculture, a multi-faceted picture of the Welsh national park emerges. (Station info).

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: In Göreme National Park, fairy chimneys and early Christian cave churches dominate the landscape. Cappadocia is also home to semi-wild horses, a symbol of the region. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Over 20 species of crocodiles, alligators and caimans live in 91 countries. Their behavior shows that there is more to teeth and scales than mere danger. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution

programme.title: The Peninsula – The Wild Stories of Iberia

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP14
programme.desc: Trong Thế chiến thứ hai, Đức Quốc xã đã đánh cắp một lượng lớn tác phẩm nghệ thuật, vàng, bạc và tiền tệ rồi cất giấu chúng trên khắp châu Âu. Trong khi một số tài sản cướp bóc đã được tìm lại thì gần 80 năm sau vẫn còn nhiều tài sản khác vẫn bị mất tích.

programme.title: THE MEGA-BRANDS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S2 EP11

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau cái chết bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học Monkey Muay Thai và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Em gái của người yêu anh, người luyện tập Kung Fu Trung Quốc, ban đầu nghi ngờ Neua phải chịu trách nhiệm, nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng em gái cô đã bị giết bởi một nhóm tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ hợp lực để bảo vệ công lý và tìm cách báo thù.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. Tào Tháo cố gắng chiêu mộ Quan Vũ vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Quan trung thành với người anh em kết nghĩa Lưu Bị, cũng là kẻ thù của Tào Tháo. Khi Quan cố gắng giải cứu vợ lẽ của Lưu Bị khỏi tay Tào Tháo, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu để vượt qua. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: NHIỆM VỤ NGUY HIỂM - MUNITIONS HIJACKING CASE
programme.desc: Đặc vụ Wen được giao nhiệm vụ bí mật cho một đại lý vũ khí ở Đông Nam Á để xác định vị trí và phá hủy kho đạn dược. Tuy nhiên, cuối cùng khi tìm thấy chúng, anh bị tấn công bởi những tên xã hội đen vô danh và phải hợp tác với đồng đội của mình để thu hồi vũ khí và ngăn chặn thảm họa.
